headline: Toronto bar could lose liquor licence after customer served 14 beers and later died falling down stairs
briefing: Top stories right now: Toronto bar could lose liquor licence after customer served 14 beers and later died falling down stairs; US judge halts construction of Trump’s triumphal arch in Washington, DC; and Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis.

keyDates.label: U.S. October jobs report
keyDates.why: A strong report could push interest rates higher, which affects Canadian borrowing costs too.

keyDates.label: Canada and U.S. October jobs reports
keyDates.why: Both reports land today; economists expect Canadian unemployment near 6.5% after September's 68,000 job loss, which shapes interest-rate bets.

keyDates.label: TTC Line 2 weekend closure
keyDates.why: Subway service is shut between St. George and Broadview on Nov. 7-8, and two GO lines also close that weekend.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada deliberations summary
keyDates.why: The bank publishes its Summary of Deliberations behind its rate hike, with hints on future moves.

keyDates.label: Target for certified state results
keyDates.why: Some close U.S. races, such as ranked-choice contests, may not be final until late November.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
keyDates.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.

stories.backstory: OSAP is Ontario's student loan and grant program. Students and compliant colleges say the blanket pause hurts those who did nothing wrong.
